items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The utils.py change is the same as the reference. It is a short `if auth:` block with a clear two-line comment, and it follows the existing style: single quotes and `'@'.join([auth, netloc])`.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The code fix is minimal and uses parse_url's existing auth field. But the patch also deletes the unrelated files docs/dev/authors.rst and docs/dev/contributing.rst (212 lines). That is stray, out-of-scope change in the diff.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard keeps the old path for URLs without credentials, and auth is added back exactly as parse_url returned it. No exceptions are swallowed and there are no magic constants.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged. The only change is `netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])`, using parse_url's auth. There is no urllib3 pinning and no Python-version check, and all 185 pass-to-pass tests pass.
